## Things worth saying no to it for

<!-- Honest answers help. Auspex holds three lines: it is a **read-only**
     observer of harness stores, it writes only under `~/.auspex/`, and it
     makes no network calls of any kind. It also runs all day beside the
     agents it watches, so anything that polls, animates off-screen, or scans
     a whole store per frame has to earn it (AGENTS.md § 4.1).

     If the idea needs one of those relaxed, say which and why. -->
